name: Ramesh Indira
bio:
**Ramesh Indira** is an accomplished Indian film director, screenwriter, and actor who works predominantly in Kannada cinema. Known for his multifaceted contributions to the industry, transitioning successfully from television direction and creative roles to feature filmmaking and character acting, he has established a strong and respected presence in Sandalwood.

Born and raised in Bengaluru, Karnataka, Ramesh built a solid foundation in the television and media landscape. He worked extensively in Kannada television as a prominent director and creative head associated with Shruti Naidu Film Production, helming popular daily serials such as Mahadevi. His deep understanding of narrative pacing and character driven storytelling on television eventually paved the way for his transition to the silver screen.

He made his feature film directorial debut with the critically acclaimed 2019 emotional comedy drama Premier Padmini, starring Jaggesh, Sudha Rani, and Pramod Panju. The film won widespread praise for its sensitive handling of modern urban relationships, witty dialogue, and strong performances, instantly marking him as a promising filmmaker in Sandalwood.

Following his directorial success, Ramesh expanded his creative portfolio into acting, where he quickly gained massive recognition for playing intense, menacing, and memorable character roles. He made a strong impact as Suryanarayana in Prashanth Neel's blockbuster action epic K.G.F: Chapter 2 (2022). He further solidified his reputation as a formidable character actor with his chilling portrayal of the primary antagonist in Hemanth M. Rao’s acclaimed romantic drama Sapta Sagaradaache Ello Side B (2023).

His prolific acting career has since expanded across a wide range of diverse projects in contemporary South Indian cinema. His extensive filmography includes notable appearances in films such as Kotee (2024), Veera Dheera Sooran: Part 2 (2025), Brat (2025), Karavali (2026), and Balaramana Dinagalu (2026). Balancing filmmaking, screenwriting, and impactful character performances, he remains an integral and versatile creative force in the film industry.

credits.title: Halka Don
credits.overview: The film follows Don, a charismatic but unsuspecting protagonist who gets embroiled in local underworld rivalries when he unwittingly becomes the face of a powerful gang.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

credits.title: Bail
credits.overview: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

credits.title: Spark
credits.overview: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop in the process. As he digs deeper , he uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to the hidden mastermind behind it all.

credits.title: Irumudi
credits.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

credits.title: Karavali
credits.overview: Karavali is a film that explores the struggles between man and nature, set against the raw, untamed beauty of coastal Karnataka. The story revolves around the world of Kambala, a traditional annual buffalo race, showcasing the unique culture and challenges of the region.

credits.title: Lenin
credits.overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

credits.title: Balaramana Dinagalu
credits.overview: Balarama, an ordinary young man from a remote village in Karnataka, becomes a dreaded gangster who rules Bangalore. Set in 1980s Bangalore, it tells a gripping story of nostalgia, power, passion, love, and betrayal.

credits.title: Brat
credits.overview: A son’s rebellion against his father’s strict moral code leads to a tense adventure. Kristy challenges Constable Mahadevaiah’s unwavering honesty as he pursues his own path.

credits.title: Veera Dheera Sooran: Part 2
credits.overview: Kaali is a provision store owner and a loving husband and father, is brought back into the life of crime, when his former boss's son is being hunted by the police.

credits.title: Bheema
credits.overview: Bheema, a gangster, wages a war against Dragon Manju, an aspiring politician and drug dealer, for supplying drugs in his locality and making the youngsters to become drug addicts.

credits.title: Kotee
credits.overview: In his quest for an honest fortune to provide for his sister's marriage and a future in the corrupt Janatha city, a truthful common man- Kotee defies the powerful gang leader Dinoo Saavkaar. When Kotee's defiance leads to mounting debts, he faces a life-altering choice to Eliminate Or be Eliminated

credits.title: Kaiva
credits.overview: Inspired from the true incidents occurred in Bengaluru - 1983, Kaiva brings the visual grandeur of Old Bengaluru showing the lights of world famous Bengaluru Karaga and the dark underworld of the city as well.

credits.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello - Side B
credits.overview: Ten years after the events of Side A, Manu is released from prison into an unfamiliar world. Struggling to move past his guilt, he sets out to check on Priya from a distance while trying to rebuild his life, only to find himself drawn into new entanglements as he seeks closure and redemption.

credits.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello – Side A
credits.overview: Manu, a car driver, and Priya, an aspiring singer, dream of building a quiet life together by the sea. Desperate to secure their financial future, Manu takes a reckless shortcut that lands him in prison, putting their relationship to the ultimate test against separation and harsh reality.

credits.title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
credits.overview: The blood-soaked land of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) has a new overlord now - Rocky, whose name strikes fear in the heart of his foes. credits.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
credits.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.
